sanskrit: etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhir doṣair eṣa samanvitaḥ tvayocyamānaḥ śreyo 'pi saṃrambhān na grahīṣyati
english: Possessed of these and many other faults, even if spoken to by you about what is better, he will not accept it out of arrogance.

sanskrit: senāsamudayaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthivaṃ madhusūdana kṛtārthaṃ manyate bāla ātmānam avicakṣaṇaḥ
english: Seeing the assembled army of kings, O Madhusudana, the foolish and undiscerning one considers his purpose already accomplished.

sanskrit: ekaḥ karṇaḥ parāñ jetuṃ samartha iti niścitam dhārtarāṣṭrasya durbuddheḥ sa śamaṃ nopayāsyati
english: It is the firm conviction of that evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra that Karna alone is capable of conquering the enemy — he will not resort to peace.

sanskrit: bhīṣme droṇe kṛpe karṇe droṇaputre jayadrathe bhūyasīṃ vartate vṛttiṃ na śame kurute manaḥ
english: He places great reliance on Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, the son of Drona, and Jayadratha; his mind is not inclined toward peace.

sanskrit: niścitaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ sakarṇānāṃ janārdana bhīṣmadroṇakṛpān pārthā na śaktāḥ prativīkṣitum
english: O Janardana, it is the settled conviction of the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with Karna, that the Pandavas are incapable of standing before Bhishma, Drona, and Kripa.

sanskrit: saṃvic ca dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ sarveṣām eva keśava śame prayatamānasya tava saubhrātrakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
english: And the understanding of all the sons of Dhritarashtra, O Keshava, regarding you who strive for peace and desire fraternal harmony —

sanskrit: na pāṇḍavānām asmābhiḥ pratideyaṃ yathocitam iti vyavasitās teṣu vacanaṃ syān nirarthakam
english: — is that 'We need not return to the Pandavas what is rightfully theirs.' To them your words will be fruitless.

sanskrit: yatra sūktaṃ duruktaṃ ca samaṃ syān madhusūdana na tatra pralapet prājño badhireṣv iva gāyanaḥ
english: Where a word well spoken and a word ill spoken are treated alike, O Madhusudana, a wise man should not speak there — like a singer performing before the deaf.

sanskrit: avijānatsu mūḍheṣu nirmaryādeṣu mādhava na tvaṃ vākyaṃ bruvan yuktaś cāṇḍāleṣu dvijo yathā
english: O Madhava, you would not do right in speaking among those who are ignorant, foolish, and devoid of restraint — like a brahmin addressing outcastes.

sanskrit: so 'yaṃ balastho mūḍhaś ca na kariṣyati te vacaḥ tasmin nirarthakaṃ vākyam uktaṃ saṃpatsyate tava
english: This one, resting on his strength and being foolish, will not follow your words; whatever you say to him will turn out to be fruitless.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāpacetasām tava madhyāvataraṇaṃ mama kṛṣṇa na rocate
english: O Krishna, I do not like your entering in the midst of all those assembled there, whose minds are wicked.

sanskrit: durbuddhīnām aśiṣṭānāṃ bahūnāṃ pāpacetasām pratīpaṃ vacanaṃ madhye tava kṛṣṇa na rocate
english: O Krishna, I do not like your speaking contrary words in the midst of those many evil-minded, ill-mannered, and wicked-hearted ones.

sanskrit: anupāsitavṛddhatvāc chriyā mohāc ca darpitaḥ vayodarpād amarṣāc ca na te śreyo grahīṣyati
english: Arrogant because he has not attended upon his elders, intoxicated by prosperity, proud of his youth, and full of impatience — he will not accept what is good from you.

sanskrit: balaṃ balavad apy asya yadi vakṣyasi mādhava tvayy asya mahatī śaṅkā na kariṣyati te vacaḥ
english: Even if you speak of his strength as strong, O Madhava, his great suspicion of you will prevent him from heeding your words.

sanskrit: nedam adya yudhā śakyam indreṇāpi sahāmaraiḥ iti vyavasitāḥ sarve dhārtarāṣṭrā janārdana
english: 'This cannot be taken from us today in battle even by Indra together with the immortals' — thus are all the sons of Dhritarashtra resolved, O Janardana.

sanskrit: teṣv evam upapanneṣu kāmakrodhānuvartiṣu samartham api te vākyam asamarthaṃ bhaviṣyati
english: Since they are thus disposed, being led by desire and anger, even your capable speech will prove incapable among them.

sanskrit: madhye tiṣṭhan hastyanīkasya mando; rathāśvayuktasya balasya mūḍhaḥ duryodhano manyate vītamanyuḥ; kṛtsnā mayeyaṃ pṛthivī jiteti
english: Standing in the midst of his elephant divisions, of his forces equipped with chariots and horses, the fool Duryodhana — devoid of real ire — thinks: 'All this earth has been conquered by me.'

sanskrit: āśaṃsate dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putro; mahārājyam asapatnaṃ pṛthivyām tasmiñ śamaḥ kevalo nopalabhyo; baddhaṃ santam āgataṃ manyate 'rtham
english: The son of Dhritarashtra hopes for sovereign rule of the earth without a rival; in him peace alone is not to be found — he considers what he seeks as already bound and delivered.

sanskrit: paryasteyaṃ pṛthivī kālapakvā; duryodhanārthe pāṇḍavān yoddhukāmāḥ samāgatāḥ sarvayodhāḥ pṛthivyāṃ; rājānaś ca kṣitipālaiḥ sametāḥ
english: This earth, ripened by time, is ready to be overturned; all warriors of the earth, eager to fight for Duryodhana's sake against the Pandavas, have gathered, and kings along with their protectors.

sanskrit: sarve caite kṛtavairāḥ purastāt; tvayā rājāno hṛtasārāś ca kṛṣṇa tavodvegāt saṃśritā dhārtarāṣṭrān; susaṃhatāḥ saha karṇena vīrāḥ
english: All these kings who formerly had enmity with you, O Krishna, and who had their essence taken away by you — out of dread of you they have joined the sons of Dhritarashtra; those heroes are firmly united together with Karna.

sanskrit: tyaktātmānaḥ saha duryodhanena; sṛṣṭā yoddhuṃ pāṇḍavān sarvayodhāḥ teṣāṃ madhye praviśethā yadi tvaṃ; na tan mataṃ mama dāśārha vīra
english: All those warriors, who have abandoned themselves along with Duryodhana and are set loose to fight the Pandavas — O hero of the Dasharha clan, it is not my wish that you enter into their midst.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ bahūnāṃ duṣṭacetasām kathaṃ madhyaṃ prapadyethāḥ śatrūṇāṃ śatrukarśana
english: How could you, O crusher of enemies, go into the middle of those many enemies of wicked minds who are assembled there?

sanskrit: sarvathā tvaṃ mahābāho devair api durutsahaḥ prabhāvaṃ pauruṣaṃ buddhiṃ jānāmi tava śatruhan
english: O great-armed one, you are difficult to overcome in every way even by the gods — I know your power, your valor, and your intelligence, O slayer of enemies.

sanskrit: yā me prītiḥ pāṇḍaveṣu bhūyaḥ sā tvayi mādhava premṇā ca bahumānāc ca sauhṛdāc ca bravīmy aham
english: The affection I have for the Pandavas is even greater for you, O Madhava; it is out of love, high regard, and friendship that I speak thus.

sanskrit: bhagavān uvāca yathā brūyān mahāprājño yathā brūyād vicakṣaṇaḥ yathā vācyas tvadvidhena suhṛdā madvidhaḥ suhṛt
english: The Blessed Lord said: As a man of great wisdom would speak, as a discerning man would speak, as a friend like yourself should address a friend like me —

sanskrit: dharmārthayuktaṃ tathyaṃ ca yathā tvayy upapadyate tathā vacanam ukto 'smi tvayaitat pitṛmātṛvat
english: — so indeed, as befits you, words endowed with righteousness and purpose, truthful — thus have you addressed me, like a father or mother.

sanskrit: satyaṃ prāptaṃ ca yuktaṃ cāpy evam eva yathāttha mām śṛṇuṣvāgamane hetuṃ vidurāvahito bhava
english: It is true, fitting, and appropriate — just as you have told me. Now listen attentively, O Vidura, to the reason for my coming; be attentive.

sanskrit: daurātmyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vairitām sarvam etad ahaṃ jānan kṣattaḥ prāpto 'dya kauravān
english: O Kshatta, knowing all of this — the wickedness of the son of Dhritarashtra and the hostility of the Kshatriyas — I have come today to the Kauravas.

sanskrit: paryastāṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ sāśvāṃ sarathakuñjarām yo mocayen mṛtyupāśāt prāpnuyād dharmam uttamam
english: One who could free the entire earth, with its horses, chariots, and elephants, from the noose of death would attain the highest merit.

sanskrit: dharmakāryaṃ yatañ śaktyā na cec chaknoti mānavaḥ prāpto bhavati tat puṇyam atra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
english: A person who strives to the best of his ability for a righteous deed, even if he fails to accomplish it, still attains that merit — of this I have no doubt.

sanskrit: manasā cintayan pāpaṃ karmaṇā nābhirocayan na prāpnoti phalaṃ tasya evaṃ dharmavido viduḥ
english: One who contemplates evil in the mind but does not delight in carrying it out by deed does not reap its fruit — thus do those who know righteousness understand.

sanskrit: so 'haṃ yatiṣye praśamaṃ kṣattaḥ kartum amāyayā kurūṇāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ ca saṃgrāme vinaśiṣyatām
english: So I shall strive, O Kshatta, without guile, to bring about peace for the Kurus and the Srinjayas who will perish in battle.

sanskrit: seyam āpan mahāghorā kuruṣv eva samutthitā karṇaduryodhanakṛtā sarve hy ete tadanvayāḥ
english: This terrible calamity has arisen among the Kurus themselves, created by Karna and Duryodhana — all others simply follow in their wake.

sanskrit: vyasanaiḥ kliśyamānaṃ hi yo mitraṃ nābhipadyate anunīya yathāśakti taṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ vidur budhāḥ
english: One who does not approach a friend being afflicted by calamities to pacify him according to his ability — the wise know such a person to be cruel.

sanskrit: ā keśagrahaṇān mitram akāryāt saṃnivartayan avācyaḥ kasya cid bhavati kṛtayatno yathābalam
english: One who restrains a friend from improper action up to the point of seizing him by the hair, having made effort to the best of his ability, is not reproachable by anyone.

sanskrit: tat samarthaṃ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam dhārtarāṣṭraḥ sahāmātyo grahītuṃ vidurārhati
english: That capable, auspicious word, endowed with righteousness and purpose and beneficial — the son of Dhritarashtra along with his ministers ought to receive it.

sanskrit: hitaṃ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca pṛthivyāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca yatiṣye 'ham amāyayā
english: For what is beneficial to the sons of Dhritarashtra, to the Pandavas, and likewise to the Kshatriyas of the earth — for that I shall strive without guile.

sanskrit: hite prayatamānaṃ māṃ śaṅked duryodhano yadi hṛdayasya ca me prītir ānṛṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati
english: Even if Duryodhana suspects me while I am striving for his benefit, still my heart will have joy and I shall be free of obligation.

sanskrit: jñātīnāṃ hi mitho bhede yan mitraṃ nābhipadyate sarvayatnena madhyasthaṃ na tan mitraṃ vidur budhāḥ
english: For when kinsmen are divided among themselves, a friend who does not step forward with every effort to act as mediator — the wise do not consider that to be a true friend.

sanskrit: na māṃ brūyur adharmajñā mūḍhā asuhṛdas tathā śakto nāvārayat kṛṣṇaḥ saṃrabdhān kurupāṇḍavān
english: Let not those ignorant of righteousness, those foolish, those who are no friends say of me: 'Krishna, though capable, did not restrain the Kurus and Pandavas when they were in fury.'

sanskrit: ubhayoḥ sādhayann artham aham āgata ity uta tatra yatnam ahaṃ kṛtvā gaccheyaṃ nṛṣv avācyatām
english: Rather, let it be said that I came serving the interests of both sides, and having made effort there, I may depart free of blame among men.

sanskrit: mama dharmārthayuktaṃ hi śrutvā vākyam anāmayam na ced ādāsyate bālo diṣṭasya vaśam eṣyati
english: For if the foolish one, having heard my word that is endowed with righteousness and purpose and free from harm, does not accept it — he will come under the power of fate.

sanskrit: ahāpayan pāṇḍavārthaṃ yathāvac; chamaṃ kurūṇāṃ yadi cācareyam puṇyaṃ ca me syāc caritaṃ mahārthaṃ; mucyeraṃś ca kuravo mṛtyupāśāt
english: Without abandoning the cause of the Pandavas, if I were to bring about peace for the Kurus as is proper, my conduct would be meritorious and of great purpose, and the Kurus would be freed from the noose of death.

sanskrit: api vācaṃ bhāṣamāṇasya kāvyāṃ; dharmārāmām arthavatīm ahiṃsrām avekṣeran dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ samarthāṃ; māṃ ca prāptaṃ kuravaḥ pūjayeyuḥ
english: May the sons of Dhritarashtra heed my speech — poetic, delighting in righteousness, meaningful, harmless, and capable — and may the Kurus honor me who has come to them.

sanskrit: na cāpi mama paryāptāḥ sahitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ kruddhasya pramukhe sthātuṃ siṃhasyevetare mṛgāḥ
english: And all the kings assembled together are not sufficient to stand before me when I am angered — just as other animals cannot stand before a lion.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca ity evam uktvā vacanaṃ vṛṣṇīnām ṛṣabhas tadā śayane sukhasaṃsparśe śiśye yadusukhāvahaḥ
english: Vaishampayana said: Having thus spoken these words, the bull among the Vrishnis, who was the source of joy for the Yadus, lay down on a pleasant soft bed.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tathā kathayator eva tayor buddhimatos tadā śivā nakṣatrasaṃpannā sā vyatīyāya śarvarī
english: Vaishampayana said: While those two wise ones were thus conversing, that auspicious night filled with stars passed away.

sanskrit: dharmārthakāmayuktāś ca vicitrārthapadākṣarāḥ śṛṇvato vividhā vāco vidurasya mahātmanaḥ
english: Various words of that great-souled Vidura — connected with righteousness, purpose, and desire, with varied and wondrous meanings and syllables — were heard.

sanskrit: kathābhir anurūpābhiḥ kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ akāmasyeva kṛṣṇasya sā vyatīyāya śarvarī
english: With tales befitting each theme, that night passed away for Krishna of boundless splendor as if he desired no sleep.

sanskrit: tatas tu svarasaṃpannā bahavaḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ keśavaṃ pratyabodhayan
english: Then many bards and panegyrists endowed with melodious voices awakened Keshava with the sounds of conches and kettledrums.

sanskrit: tata utthāya dāśārha ṛṣabhaḥ sarvasātvatām sarvam āvaśyakaṃ cakre prātaḥkāryaṃ janārdanaḥ
english: Then, having risen, Janardana, that scion of the Dasharha line, the bull among all the Satvatas, performed all the necessary morning duties.

sanskrit: kṛtodakāryajapyaḥ sa hutāgniḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ tata ādityam udyantam upātiṣṭhata mādhavaḥ
english: Having completed his water rites and silent prayers, having offered oblations into the fire, and having adorned himself, Madhava then stood in reverence before the rising sun.

sanskrit: atha duryodhanaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ saṃdhyāṃ tiṣṭhantam abhyetya dāśārham aparājitam
english: Then Duryodhana and Shakuni, son of Subala, approached Krishna, the unconquered scion of the Dasharha clan, as he stood at his twilight prayers.

sanskrit: ācakṣetāṃ tu kṛṣṇasya dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ sabhāgatam kurūṃś ca bhīṣmapramukhān rājñaḥ sarvāṃś ca pārthivān
english: They informed Krishna that Dhritarashtra had gone to the assembly hall, along with the Kurus headed by Bhishma, all the kings, and all the ruling lords.

sanskrit: tvām arthayante govinda divi śakram ivāmarāḥ tāv abhyanandad govindaḥ sāmnā paramavalgunā
english: 'They desire your presence, O Govinda, as the immortals desire Shakra in heaven.' Govinda greeted them both with supremely gentle and conciliatory words.

sanskrit: tato vimala āditye brāhmaṇebhyo janārdanaḥ dadau hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi gāś cāśvāṃś ca paraṃtapaḥ
english: Then, when the sun had risen clear, Janardana, that scorcher of enemies, gave to the brahmins gold, garments, cows, and horses.

sanskrit: visṛṣṭavantaṃ ratnāni dāśārham aparājitam tiṣṭhantam upasaṃgamya vavande sārathis tadā
english: Then his charioteer approached the unconquered scion of the Dasharha line as he stood there having distributed the jewels, and paid his respects.

sanskrit: tam upasthitam ājñāya rathaṃ divyaṃ mahāmanāḥ mahābhraghananirghoṣaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
english: Knowing him to have arrived, the great-minded one called for his divine chariot — roaring like great clouds and thunderstorms, adorned with every kind of jewel.

sanskrit: agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāṃś ca janārdanaḥ kaustubhaṃ maṇim āmucya śriyā paramayā jvalan
english: Janardana circumambulated the sacred fire and the brahmins, donned the Kaustubha gem, and blazed with supreme glory.

sanskrit: kurubhiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo vṛṣṇibhiś cābhirakṣitaḥ ātiṣṭhata rathaṃ śauriḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ
english: Surrounded by the Kurus and guarded by the Vrishnis, Krishna, the son of Shura, delight of all the Yadavas, mounted his chariot.

sanskrit: anvāruroha dāśārhaṃ viduraḥ sarvadharmavit sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varam
english: Vidura, knower of all righteousness, best among all breathing beings, foremost among all upholders of virtue, also mounted alongside the scion of the Dasharha line.

sanskrit: tato duryodhanaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ dvitīyena rathenainam anvayātāṃ paraṃtapam
english: Then Duryodhana and Shakuni, son of Subala, followed behind that scorcher of foes in a second chariot.

sanskrit: sātyakiḥ kṛtavarmā ca vṛṣṇīnāṃ ca mahārathāḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nuyayuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rathair aśvair gajair api
english: Satyaki, Kritavarma, and the great chariot-warriors of the Vrishnis followed behind Krishna with chariots, horses, and elephants.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ hemapariṣkārā yuktāḥ paramavājibhiḥ gacchatāṃ ghoṣiṇaś citrāś cāru babhrājire rathāḥ
english: Their chariots, adorned with gold trappings and yoked to the finest steeds, gleamed beautifully as they went, resounding and magnificent.

sanskrit: saṃmṛṣṭasaṃsiktarajaḥ pratipede mahāpatham rājarṣicaritaṃ kāle kṛṣṇo dhīmāñ śriyā jvalan
english: With the dust swept and sprinkled down, the wise Krishna, blazing with glory, proceeded along the great highway in the manner proper to royal sages, befitting the time.

sanskrit: tataḥ prayāte dāśārhe prāvādyantaikapuṣkarāḥ śaṅkhāś ca dadhmire tatra vādyāny anyāni yāni ca
english: As the scion of the Dasharha line set forth, single-drumhead kettledrums were sounded, conches were blown, and various other instruments were played there.

sanskrit: pravīrāḥ sarvalokasya yuvānaḥ siṃhavikramāḥ parivārya rathaṃ śaurer agacchanta paraṃtapāḥ
english: The foremost heroes of all the world — young men of lion-like gait, scorchers of foes — proceeded surrounding the chariot of the son of Shura.

sanskrit: tato 'nye bahusāhasrā vicitrādbhutavāsasaḥ asiprāsāyudhadharāḥ kṛṣṇasyāsan puraḥsarāḥ
english: Then others, many thousands of them, wearing varied and wondrous garments and bearing swords, lances, and weapons, marched ahead of Krishna.

sanskrit: gajāḥ paraḥśatās tatra varāś cāśvāḥ sahasraśaḥ prayāntam anvayur vīraṃ dāśārham aparājitam
english: More than a hundred elephants and thousands of the finest horses followed behind that hero, the unconquered scion of the Dasharha line, as he advanced.

sanskrit: puraṃ kurūṇāṃ saṃvṛttaṃ draṣṭukāmaṃ janārdanam savṛddhabālaṃ sastrīkaṃ rathyāgatam ariṃdamam
english: The city of the Kurus was crowded with people — elders, children, and women together — who had come into the streets wishing to see Janardana, that subduer of enemies, as he passed.

sanskrit: vedikāpāśritābhiś ca samākrāntāny anekaśaḥ pracalantīva bhāreṇa yoṣidbhir bhavanāny uta
english: The houses too were crowded with women who had taken their places at the terraces and balconies — as if swaying under their weight.

sanskrit: saṃpūjyamānaḥ kurubhiḥ saṃśṛṇvan vividhāḥ kathāḥ yathārhaṃ pratisatkurvan prekṣamāṇaḥ śanair yayau
english: Being honored by the Kurus, listening to various conversations, responding to each as was fitting, and gazing about, he proceeded slowly.

sanskrit: tataḥ sabhāṃ samāsādya keśavasyānuyāyinaḥ saśaṅkhair veṇunirghoṣair diśaḥ sarvā vyanādayan
english: Then, upon reaching the assembly hall, the followers of Keshava filled all the directions with the sounds of conches and flutes.

sanskrit: tataḥ sā samitiḥ sarvā rājñām amitatejasām saṃprākampata harṣeṇa kṛṣṇāgamanakāṅkṣayā
english: Then that entire assembly of kings of boundless splendor trembled with joy in anticipation of Krishna's arrival.

sanskrit: tato 'bhyāśagate kṛṣṇe samahṛṣyan narādhipāḥ śrutvā taṃ rathanirghoṣaṃ parjanyaninadopamam
english: Then, as Krishna drew near, the lords of men rejoiced, hearing the sound of his chariot which was like the roar of a storm cloud.

sanskrit: āsādya tu sabhādvāram ṛṣabhaḥ sarvasātvatām avatīrya rathāc chauriḥ kailāsaśikharopamāt
english: Having reached the door of the assembly hall, the bull among all the Satvatas, the son of Shura, descended from his chariot which was like the peak of Mount Kailasa.

sanskrit: nagameghapratīkāśāṃ jvalantīm iva tejasā mahendrasadanaprakhyāṃ praviveśa sabhāṃ tataḥ
english: He then entered that assembly hall which resembled a mountain and a cloud, blazing as if with energy, resembling the palace of great Indra.

sanskrit: pāṇau gṛhītvā viduraṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ jyotīṃṣy ādityavad rājan kurūn pracchādayañ śriyā
english: Taking Vidura and Satyaki by the hand, O king, the greatly renowned one — like the sun outshining other luminaries — overwhelmed the Kurus with his radiance.

sanskrit: agrato vāsudevasya karṇaduryodhanāv ubhau vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛtavarmā ca āsan kṛṣṇasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
english: Both Karna and Duryodhana were in front of Vasudeva, while the Vrishnis and Kritavarma were behind Krishna.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya bhīṣmadroṇādayas tataḥ āsanebhyo 'calan sarve pūjayanto janārdanam
english: Then Bhishma, Drona, and the others, with Dhritarashtra at their head, all rose from their seats, honoring Janardana.
